sections.content:
Append Alex and include unmatched employees.

```bash

join -a 1 employees.txt salaries.txt
```

sections.title: Joining on a Different Field
sections.content:
Sort both inputs by their join keys before joining department names.

```bash
printf '%s\n' 'Engineering ENG' 'Marketing MKT' 'Sales SLS' 'HR HRS' 'Finance FIN' 'IT ITS' > departments.txt
sort -k3,3 employees.txt > employees_by_department.txt
sort departments.txt > departments_sorted.txt
join -1 3 -2 1 employees_by_department.txt departments_sorted.txt
```
sections.content_vi:
Sắp xếp cả hai đầu vào theo khóa phòng ban trước khi ghép.

```bash
printf '%s\n' 'Engineering ENG' 'Marketing MKT' 'Sales SLS' 'HR HRS' 'Finance FIN' 'IT ITS' > departments.txt
sort -k3,3 employees.txt > employees_by_department.txt
sort departments.txt > departments_sorted.txt
join -1 3 -2 1 employees_by_department.txt departments_sorted.txt
```
